summary.en: A compact wired gateway for an assessed office, institution or multi-building network.
summary.sw: Gateway ya nyaya kwa mtandao wa ofisi, taasisi au majengo kadhaa baada ya tathmini.

value.sw: Nafasi 1 ya 10G SFP+; moduli huchaguliwa kando

compatibility.en: Wired router, not a Wi-Fi access point. This UG variant has PoE input, not PoE output for access points. Match SFP+ modules and power arrangements. Exact hardware revision, power supply, modules and configuration are confirmed in the quotation. Device link rates are not a guaranteed internet speed.
compatibility.sw: Hii ni router ya nyaya; haina Wi-Fi. Toleo hili lina PoE-in, si PoE-out kwa AP. SFP+ inahitaji moduli inayofaa. Toleo la kifaa, umeme wake, moduli na usanidi huthibitishwa kwenye nukuu. Kasi ya port si ahadi ya kasi ya intaneti.

images.alt: MikroTik hEX refresh · E50UG — manufacturer product photograph

summary.en: Practical wired routing for smaller offices, shops and a clearly scoped network.
summary.sw: Router ya nyaya kwa ofisi ndogo, maduka na mtandao wenye mahitaji yaliyobainishwa.

compatibility.en: Wired routing only: no built-in Wi-Fi or access-point PoE output. Match the passive PoE input requirements; do not assume interchangeable power supplies. Exact hardware revision, power supply, modules and configuration are confirmed in the quotation. Device link rates are not a guaranteed internet speed.
compatibility.sw: Router ya nyaya yenye passive PoE-in. Haina Wi-Fi wala PoE-out ya kuwasha AP. Hakiki chanzo chake cha umeme. Toleo la kifaa, umeme wake, moduli na usanidi huthibitishwa kwenye nukuu. Kasi ya port si ahadi ya kasi ya intaneti.

name: EAP650
generation: EAP650; hardware revision confirmed in quotation

images.alt: TP-Link Omada EAP650 — manufacturer product photograph

summary.en: Ceiling-mount Wi-Fi 6 for planned office, school and hospitality coverage.
summary.sw: Wi-Fi 6 ya kufungwa darini kwa ofisi, shule na hoteli zenye mpango wa coverage.

value.en: Ceiling/wall mount; power matched to revision

compatibility.en: Requires a suitable wired uplink and power supply. Controller, roaming and mesh features depend on the selected revision, firmware and complete deployment. Radio rate is not user throughput. Exact hardware revision, power supply, modules and configuration are confirmed in the quotation. Device link rates are not a guaranteed internet speed.
compatibility.sw: AP hii inahitaji uplink na umeme unaofaa. Vipengele vya controller na roaming hutegemea matoleo na usanidi wa mfumo. Toleo la kifaa, umeme wake, moduli na usanidi huthibitishwa kwenye nukuu. Kasi ya port si ahadi ya kasi ya intaneti.

images.alt: TP-Link Omada EAP225-Outdoor — manufacturer product photograph

summary.en: Outdoor Wi-Fi coverage for assessed courtyards, compounds and hospitality areas.
summary.sw: Wi-Fi ya nje kwa viwanja, maeneo yenye majengo na sehemu za hoteli baada ya tathmini.

value.sw: Ndani/nje; ufungaji na kinga hupangwa kwa eneo

compatibility.en: An outdoor AP is not automatically a building-to-building backhaul. Survey obstruction, weather exposure, earthing/surge protection, uplink and model-specific power requirements. Exact hardware revision, power supply, modules and configuration are confirmed in the quotation. Device link rates are not a guaranteed internet speed.
compatibility.sw: AP ya nje si mbadala wa fibre kwa kila kiungo cha majengo. Mahali, hali ya hewa, kinga na umeme hupangwa kulingana na toleo. Toleo la kifaa, umeme wake, moduli na usanidi huthibitishwa kwenye nukuu. Kasi ya port si ahadi ya kasi ya intaneti.

images.alt: TP-Link Omada SG2210MP — manufacturer product photograph

summary.en: Managed PoE+ switching for compatible IP cameras and access points, with fibre-uplink options.
summary.sw: Swichi managed ya PoE+ kwa kamera za IP na AP zinazooana, yenye chaguo la uplink ya fibre.

compatibility.en: Calculate combined PoE demand and startup margin rather than counting ports alone. SFP modules and any controller are selected separately; VLAN/ACL features require correct configuration. Exact hardware revision, power supply, modules and configuration are confirmed in the quotation. Device link rates are not a guaranteed internet speed.
compatibility.sw: Jumla ya matumizi ya PoE ya kamera na AP lazima iwe ndani ya bajeti ya kifaa. Moduli za SFP na controller huchaguliwa kando kulingana na mradi. Toleo la kifaa, umeme wake, moduli na usanidi huthibitishwa kwenye nukuu. Kasi ya port si ahadi ya kasi ya intaneti.

summary.en: Straightforward Gigabit port expansion where managed segmentation and PoE are not required.
summary.sw: Kuongeza port za Gigabit pale usimamizi wa VLAN na PoE visipohitajika.

compatibility.en: This is an unmanaged, non-PoE switch. It is not a substitute for managed VLAN control or a PoE supply. Choose the model around the actual topology and power requirements. Exact hardware revision, power supply, modules and configuration are confirmed in the quotation. Device link rates are not a guaranteed internet speed.
compatibility.sw: Hii ni swichi unmanaged isiyo na PoE. Kwa VLAN au kuwasha AP/kamera kupitia nyaya, chagua kifaa kingine kinachofaa. Toleo la kifaa, umeme wake, moduli na usanidi huthibitishwa kwenye nukuu. Kasi ya port si ahadi ya kasi ya intaneti.
